newsitem.title: USA: US Midwest direct hogs seen flat-off $0.50-dealers.
newsitem.headline: US Midwest direct hogs seen flat-off $0.50-dealers.

text.p: U.S. Midwest direct cash hog prices Friday were seen mostly steady on projections for lighter marketings, except for Illinois areas, where prices were expected $0.50 per cwt lower on large hog movement, livestock dealers and packer buyers said.
Top prices for hogs delivered to plants in Iowa and southern Minnesota could range from $55.50 to $56.00. Illinois top prices at plants were seen at $53.00 to $53.50.
Indiana/Ohio top prices at the plant could range from $53.50 to $54.50, dealers there said.
Hog movement increased the past two days as weather conditions improved, sources said.
Interior Iowa and southern Minnesota hog marketings Wednesday totalled 116,000 head, USDA said, well above that day's estimate of 105,000.
Thursday's estimate was 110,000 head, compared with 100,000 a week ago and 101,000 a year ago.
Prices also were pressured by light packer demand as operating margins narrowed amid sluggish pork demand, dealers said.
